title: Yellowed Crispy Syrian Leek Fritters
description: A light and sour Syrian dish featuring leeks, perfect for a weeknight meal, these crispy fritters are vegetarian friendly and full of flavor. They are deep fried to a golden brown and served hot.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Add the chopped leeks, lemon juice, and water to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully add a few of the leek patties to the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining leek patties.
Serve the Yellowed Crispy Syrian Leek Fritters hot and enjoy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
